governance.architecture_and_history: Cupid Limited was incorporated on February 17, 1993, and subsequently listed on the BSE in 1995. The company is headquartered in Nashik, India. It has evolved into a premier manufacturer and supplier of male and female condoms, personal lubricant jelly, and In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits. The company's vision is centered on fighting against HIV/AIDS and other sexually transmitted diseases, reflecting its commitment to public health and safety on a global scale. It actively works to prevent unintended pregnancies. The company's production facility is located in Nashik, approximately 200 kilometers east of Mumbai. As of October 25, 2026, the company has 235 employees. Cupid Limited's market capitalization stands at ₹41,213.85 Crores as of October 26, 2026, classifying it as a Smallcap company.
